correctness.rationale: All finite connected components have universal vertices. After two WL rounds a vertex determines its component order from the maximum closed-neighborhood degree. Induct on largest component size, remove all universal vertices from components at that size, and restrict the stable equitable partition to the smaller residual forest. The induction hypothesis turns residual colours into orbit refinements; universal-colour neighbour counts determine residual component-type multisets, and pointed residual orbits provide an automorphism mapping any same-colour vertex pair. The converse follows from automorphism invariance. Forest and independent atlas checks through 11 and 7 vertices respectively passed; neither is offered as an infinite proof.
